title: Buddha's Wall of Flavors Stir Fry
description: A vibrant and flavorful stir fry dish inspired by Chinese cuisine, featuring beetroot as the star ingredient. This recipe showcases a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and savory flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the peanuts and cook, stirring frequently, until they are lightly toasted and fragrant.
Add the grated beetroot and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes.
Add the chinese five-spice powder, sugar, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the beetroot is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional peanuts if desired.
